email.body2:
Pam, quick follow-up for Celigo.

Enablement only compounds when every rep follows a repeatable, researched first touch, yet most reps lose hours to research and CRM instead of conversations. Tightening that motion is often where the easy lift hides.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent, and I will tailor it to your reps' target accounts.
email.body3:
Pam, last bit of proof for Celigo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Celigo's reply rate likely compares to other mid-market SaaS firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enablement motion? I will tailor it to Celigo either way.
